description: A Vulcan setup. Edit it by hand or with an AI assistant, then load it on the phone: long-press the home screen, Settings, Backup & restore, Restore from a file. $schema points to a JSON Schema for this file: check an edited file against it before loading it. A file with settings but no home or data is a style: restoring it changes the settings and keeps the layout, drawer tabs and hidden apps. settings: one value per key. reference.settings lists every key, what it does, its default and the values it takes. A colour setting also takes any #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB. A value that isn't allowed is skipped and the setting keeps its default. home.items: everything on the home pages and the dock. page 0 is the first home page (settings.pages says how many); the dock is page -1 (a second dock page is -2). x and y count cells from the top left; w and h are the size in cells (default 1). The grid is settings.cols by settings.rows; the dock is one row of settings.dockCols. When home.sub is 2, home positions and sizes count half cells. Don't overlap items; one that falls off the grid moves to the first free cell. An app: {"page":0,"x":1,"y":3,"pkg":"<package>"} with pkg from reference.installedApps. cls picks one of its activities: leave it out for the main one, but give it when installedApps lists the package more than once (Google has search and voice search). Optional: label (replaces the name), swipe (an action code run when the icon is swiped up), user (a work profile number from installedApps). A folder: {"page":0,"x":0,"y":0,"folder":true,"label":"Social","children":[apps, each with page, x and y set to 0]}. An action icon: {"page":0,"x":2,"y":0,"action":"<action code>","label":"Lock"}. Action codes (gestures, swipe, action icons): see reference.actions, plus page:N (jump to page N, 0-based) and app:<pkg>/<cls>/<user> (open an app). icon (on apps, folders, action icons and in data.custom): empty for the app's own icon, or "pack:<icon pack package>:<drawable name>" for an installed icon pack. data.hidden: app keys (<pkg>/<cls>/<user>) left out of the drawer. data.groups: drawer tabs and folders, [{"name":"Social","type":"tab" or "folder","apps":[app keys],"color":"#RRGGBB" (optional, a tab's own colour)}]. data.custom: an app's name and icon everywhere it has no home-screen override, {"<app key>":{"label":"Mail","icon":""}}. data.launches: launch counts, for sorting by most used. data.drawerOrder: app keys in the order arranged by hand (the manual sort; a tab keeps its own in its apps list). data.favourites: app keys pinned above the drawer's tabs, in order. Widgets can't be made from this file; add them on the phone.
title: Vulcan Launcher backup
